description: Precedence (ADR 0026 §2 as clarified by ADR 0048: shape and limits, then signature base64url, then protected-header decoding (base64url, JSON, then per-parameter types and crit syntax), then the payload's base64url under the effective b64, then whole-header structure, then ADR 0026 §2 steps 5–9): a compact JWS whose protected header has crit ["x-a"] with no x-a (whole-header structure, ADR 0048 step 5) and whose payload is padded (payload base64url, step 4) fails with the base64url code
